49340-joseph-haydn-servant-and-master.title: Joseph Haydn Servant And Master
49340-joseph-haydn-servant-and-master.creator: Unknown
49340-joseph-haydn-servant-and-master.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “scandalously jolly” Mass of 1766, making it even more “scandalous” by the addition of some cheery wind instrument parts. Having finished a work and signed it, he would almost unfailingly add a pious inscription, such as “Soli Deo Gloria”, “Laus Deo” or “In Nomine Domini”.

arxiv-2010-12969.title: Asymptotic Enumeration of Binary Contingency Tables and Comparison with Independence Heuristic
arxiv-2010-12969.creator: Da Wu
arxiv-2010-12969.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Da Wu. For parameters n , δ , B , C n,\delta,B,C , we obtained a sharp asymptotic formula for the number of ( n + ⌊ n δ ⌋ ) 2 (n+\lfloor n^{\delta}\rfloor)^{2} -dimensional binary contingency tables with non-uniform margins taking values of ⌊ B ​ C ​ n ⌋ \lfloor BCn\rfloor and ⌊ C ​ n ⌋ \lfloor Cn\rfloor .

arxiv-2011-09986.title: Estimation of Shortest Path Covariance Matrices
arxiv-2011-09986.creator: Raj Kumar Maity, Cameron Musco
arxiv-2011-09986.description: Abstract We study the sample complexity of estimating the covariance matrix 𝚺 ∈ ℝ d × d \mathbf{\Sigma}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d} of a distribution 𝒟 \mathcal{D} over ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} given independent samples, under the assumption that 𝚺 \mathbf{\Sigma} is graph-structured .

arxiv-2101-11053.title: Response-Time Analysis and Optimization for Probabilistic Conditional Parallel DAG Tasks
arxiv-2101-11053.creator: Niklas Ueter, Mario Günzel, Jian-Jia Chen
arxiv-2101-11053.description: Abstract Real-time systems increasingly use multicore processors in order to satisfy thermal, power, and computational requirements. To exploit the architectural parallelism offered by the multicore processors, parallel task models, scheduling algorithms and response-time analyses with respect to real-time constraints have to be provided.

arxiv-2112-13204.title: Geometric algebra generation of molecular surfaces
arxiv-2112-13204.creator: Azzam Alfarraj, Guo-Wei Wei
arxiv-2112-13204.description: Abstract Geometric algebra is a powerful framework that unifies mathematics and physics. Since its revival in the middle of the 1960s by David Hestenes, it attracts great attention and has been exploited in many fields such as physics, computer science, and engineering.

arxiv-2311-03763.title: THRESHOLDING THE HIGHER CRITICISM TEST STATISTIC FOR OPTIMALITY IN A HETEROGENEOUS SETTING
arxiv-2311-03763.creator: Hock Peng Chan
arxiv-2311-03763.description: Abstract Donoho and Kipnis (2022) showed that the the higher criticism (HC) test statistic has a non-Gaussian phase transition but remarked that it is probably not optimal, in the detection of sparse differences between two large frequency tables when the counts are low.

arxiv-2407-21138.title: Enhancing Deep Hedging of Options with Implied Volatility Surface Feedback Information Thanks: We thank John Hull and Zissis Poulos for valuable feedback about this work. We also gratefully acknowledge fruitful discussions with the participants from the Banff International Research Station (BIRS), t
arxiv-2407-21138.creator: Pascal François, Geneviève Gauthier, Frédéric Godin, Carlos Octavio Pérez-Mendoza
arxiv-2407-21138.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pascal François, Geneviève Gauthier, Frédéric Godin, Carlos Octavio Pérez-Mendoza. We present a dynamic hedging scheme for S&P 500 options, where rebalancing decisions are enhanced by integrating information about the implied volatility surface dynamics. The optimal hedging strategy is obtained through a deep policy gradient-type reinforcement learning algorithm. The favorable inclusion of forward-looking information embedded in the volatility surface allows our procedure to outperform several conventional benchmarks such as practitioner and smiled-implied delta hedging procedures, both in simulation and backtesting experiments.

arxiv-2502-05437.title: Approximating the total variation distance between spin systems
arxiv-2502-05437.creator: Weiming Feng, Hongyang Liu, Minji Yang
arxiv-2502-05437.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Weiming Feng, Hongyang Liu, Minji Yang. Spin systems form an important class of undirected graphical models. For two Gibbs distributions μ \mu and ν \nu induced by two spin systems on the same graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) , we study the problem of approximating the total variation distance d TV ​ ( μ , ν ) d_{\mathrm{TV}}\left({\mu},{\nu}\right) with an ε \varepsilon -relative error.

arxiv-2503-20811.title: Equivalent Electric Model of a Macrospin
arxiv-2503-20811.creator: Steven Louis, Hannah Bradley, Vasyl Tyberkevych
arxiv-2503-20811.description: Abstract Dynamics of a ferromagnetic macrospin (e.g., a free layer of a magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ)) can be described in terms of equivalent capacitor charge Q Q and inductor flux Φ \Phi , in a manner similar to a standard electric LC circuit, but with strongly nonlinear and coupled capacitance and inductance.

arxiv-2511-22702.title: The Parkes Observatory Pulsar Data Archive DOI: 10.1017/pas.2026.xxx
arxiv-2511-22702.creator: Toomey, L. J. 1, Hobbs, G. 1, Dempsey, J. 2,4, Majewski, S. 3, Dai, S. 1, Reynolds, J. E. 1
arxiv-2511-22702.description: Abstract Data from observations of pulsars made by Murriyang, the CSIRO Parkes 64-metre radio-telescope over the last three decades are more accessible than ever before, largely due to their storage in expansive long-term archives. Containing nearly 2 million files from more than 400 Parkes pulsar projects, CSIRO’s Data Access Portal is leading the global effort in making pulsar data accessible.

arxiv-2606-30715.title: Hunting Wandering 3 < < z < < 8 Black Holes: via Spatial Offsets in Ionization Ratio and Continuum Emission
arxiv-2606-30715.creator: Urvi Thakurdesai, Anthony J. Taylor, Steven L. Finkelstein, Gene C. K. Leung, Óscar A. Chávez Ortiz, Jonathan R. Trump, Bren E. Backhaus, Nikko J. britannica-1911-aspendus.title: Aspendus (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-aspendus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-aspendus.description: Article 'Aspendus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The ruins still extant are very remarkable, and, with the noble Roman theatre, the finest in the world, have earned for the place (as is the case with certain other great monuments) a legendary connexion with Solomon’s Sheban queen. On the summit of the hillock, surrounded by a wall with three gates, lie the remains of the city.

pmc-10528810.title: Assisted Identification over Modulo-Additive Noise Channels
pmc-10528810.creator: Amos Lapidoth, Baohua Ni
pmc-10528810.description: The gain in the identification capacity afforded by a rate-limited description of the noise sequence corrupting a modulo-additive noise channel is studied. Both the classical Ahlswede–Dueck version and the Ahlswede–Cai–Ning–Zhang version, which does not allow for missed identifications, are studied.

pmc-10539962.title: Precision medicine in the era of multi-omics: can the data tsunami guide rational treatment decision?
pmc-10539962.creator: M Aldea, L Friboulet, S Apcher, F Jaulin, F Mosele, T Sourisseau, J-C Soria, S Nikolaev, F André
pmc-10539962.description: Precision medicine for cancer is rapidly moving to an approach that integrates multiple dimensions of the biology in order to model mechanisms of cancer progression in each patient. The discovery of multiple drivers per tumor challenges medical decision that faces several treatment options.

pmc-10637877.title: The impact of recreational cannabis use on neuropsychological function in epilepsy
pmc-10637877.creator: Lucy Roberts-West, Sallie Baxendale
pmc-10637877.description: Highlights•Recreational cannabis use is reported more commonly in males than females.•Cannabis use is associated with lower baseline intellectual reserves.•Cannabis use in people with epilepsy amplifies deficits in new learning.•Enhanced susceptibility of recall to distraction is also evident in this group.

pmc-10719247.title: Spectroscopic ellipsometry modelling of Cr+ implanted copper oxide thin films
pmc-10719247.creator: K Ungeheuer, K W Marszalek, M Mitura-Nowak, A Rydosz
pmc-10719247.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this paper, we present modelling of spectroscopic ellipsometry data. The measured samples are thin films of copper oxides modified with the ion implantation method. The samples were prepared using reactive magnetron sputtering. Thin films of CuO and Cu4O3 were deposited and subjected to Cr ion implantation with an energy of 15 keV and a dose of 5 × 1016 ions/cm2. The decrease in crystallinity of the thin film as a result of the implantation was inspected with X-ray diffraction measurements.

pmc-11284218.title: Field evaluation of a volatile pyrethroid spatial repellent and etofenprox treated clothing for outdoor protection against forest malaria vectors in Cambodia
pmc-11284218.creator: Élodie A Vajda, Amanda Ross, Dyna Doum, Emma L Fairbanks, Nakul Chitnis, Jeffrey Hii, Sarah J Moore, Jason H Richardson, Michael Macdonald, Siv Sovannaroth, Pen Kimheng, David J McIver, Allison Tatarsky, Neil F Lobo
pmc-11284218.description: Cambodia’s goal to eliminate malaria by 2025 is challenged by persistent transmission in forest and forest fringe areas, where people are exposed to Anopheles mosquito bites during the day and night. Volatile pyrethroid spatial repellents (VPSRs) and insecticide-treated clothing (ITC) could address these gaps.

pmc-11331150.title: Assessing actigraphy performance for daytime sleep detection following stroke: insights from inpatient monitoring in a rehabilitation hospital
pmc-11331150.creator: Jiayi E Wang, Jacob Sindorf, Pin-Wei Chen, Jessica Wu, Adrian Gonzales, Megan K O’Brien, Aashna Sunderrajan, Kristen L Knutson, Phyllis C Zee, Lisa Wolfe, Vineet M Arora, Arun Jayaraman
pmc-11331150.description: Study ObjectivesStroke can result in or exacerbate various sleep disorders. The presence of behaviors such as daytime sleepiness poststroke can indicate underlying sleep disorders which can significantly impact functional recovery and thus require prompt detection and monitoring for improved care.

pmc-11352755.title: Correction: Odegaard et al. Distinct Synaptic Vesicle Proteomic Signatures Associated with Pre- and Post-Natal Oxycodone-Exposure. Cells 2022, 11, 1740

pmc-11431700.title: Serum-Free Medium Supplemented with Haematococcus pluvialis Extracts for the Growth of Human MRC-5 Fibroblasts
pmc-11431700.creator: Eun-Jeong Koh, Seong-Yeong Heo, Areumi Park, Yeon-Ji Lee, Woon-Yong Choi, Soo-Jin Heo, Eduardo Jacob-Lopes, Leila Queiroz Zepka, Mariany Costa Deprá
pmc-11431700.description: Experiments are increasingly performed in vitro; therefore, cell culture technology is essential for scientific progress. Fetal bovine serum (FBS) is a key cell culture supplement providing growth factors, amino acids, and hormones. However, FBS is not readily available on the market, has contamination risks, and has ethical concerns.

pmc-11467901.title: Synchronous Cation-Driven and Anion-Driven Polypyrrole-Based Yarns toward In-Air Linear Actuators
pmc-11467901.creator: Amaia
pmc-11467901.description: Conducting polymers (CP) have shown great features in building textile actuators. To date, most of the yarn-based or CP-yarn actuators have been operated in liquid electrolytes in a three-electrode-cell configuration, comprising an external counter and a reference electrode. For integration in textiles, a two-electrode system is needed, where both electrodes are in a yarn format.

pmc-11492651.title: Next-generation IgA-SEQ allows for high-throughput, anaerobic, and metagenomic assessment of IgA-coated bacteria
pmc-11492651.creator: Merel van Gogh, Jonas M. Louwers, Anna Celli, Sanne Gräve, Marco C. Viveen, Sofie Bosch, Nanne K. H. de Boer, Rik J. Verheijden, Karijn P. M. Suijkerbuijk, Eelco C. Brand, Janetta Top, Bas Oldenburg, Marcel R. de Zoete
pmc-11492651.description: BackgroundThe intestinal microbiota plays a significant role in maintaining systemic and intestinal homeostasis, but can also influence diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and cancer. Certain bacterial species within the intestinal tract can chronically activate the immune system, leading to low-grade intestinal inflammation.

pmc-11523007.title: New horizons in community engagement: Virtual community engagement studios amplifying community voices about health research in New Mexico
pmc-11523007.creator: Cynthia M Killough, Julia Martinez, Holly Mata, Donna Sedillo, Pilar Sanjuan, Alexandra Roesch, Christopher Hudson, Brenda Bishop, Jose Gonzalez, Heidi Rishel Brakey, Nancy Pandhi
pmc-11523007.description: There is increasing recognition of the crucial need for robust community engagement in health research and clinical trials. Despite this awareness, challenges persist in bridging the gap between researchers and communities. Much of the current discourse focuses on addressing issues such as cultural humility and equitable partnerships.

pmc-11543782.title: Assessment and Quantification of Foam Cells and Lipid Droplet–Accumulating Microglia in Mouse Brain Tissue Using BODIPY Staining
pmc-11543782.creator: Boaz K. Maiyo, Sanna H. Loppi, Helena W. Morrison, Kristian P. Doyle
pmc-11543782.description: This paper presents a refined, user-friendly protocol for using boron-dipyrromethene (BODIPY) to assess and quantify foam cells and lipid droplet–accumulating microglia (LDAM) in mouse brain tissue. The protocol aims to enhance existing methodologies by offering precise and efficient evaluation of foam cells and LDAM burden in various neuropathological conditions linked to lipid metabolism and neuroinflammation.

pmc-11587603.title: Neoliberalism in academia: reflections from a parasitologist
pmc-11587603.creator: Robin B. Gasser
pmc-11587603.description: This article examines the major transformation within the higher education sector, specifically the shift from traditional academia to neoliberal academia, with an emphasis on its impact on academics who entered the field in the 2000s. Many of these individuals may not fully recognise the extensive political and structural changes driven by neoliberalism over the past 2 decades.

pmc-12539528.title: Neuroinflammation as a Link in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s Diseases: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12539528.creator: Anna Tylutka, Piotr Żabiński, Łukasz Walas, Agnieszka Zembron-Lacny
pmc-12539528.description: Neuroinflammation plays a critical role in Alzheimer's (AD) and Parkinson's diseases (PD) onset, pathophysiology, and progression. The aim of our meta-analysis was to review the available literature to assess the role of neuroinflammation in the pathogenesis of the two most common neurological diseases: Parkinson's disease and Alzheimer's disease.

pmc-12721116.title: Extramedullary plasmacytoma of the tibial nerve: illustrative case
pmc-12721116.creator: Parsa Nilchian, Max Reed, Andrew B Yang, Gary Kocharian, Kai-Ming Fu
pmc-12721116.description: BACKGROUNDExtramedullary plasmacytomas (EMPs) are rare plasma cell tumors forming outside the bone marrow. EMPs spread to soft tissues with a predilection for the head and neck region. Therefore, EMPs are rarely included in the differential for peripheral nerve sheath tumors (PNSTs).

pmc-13238206.title: P2X7 receptor: An emerging therapeutic target in acute myeloid leukemia (Review)
pmc-13238206.creator: Yunqing Liu, Hongfan Xue, Hanheng Mai, Tan Sang, Zonghong Li, Na Wang, Lili Feng
pmc-13238206.description: The P2X7 receptor (P2X7R) is a ligand-gated ion channel that exhibits bifunctional properties, switching between a cation-permeable channel and a large cytolytic pore. In acute myeloid leukemia (AML), P2X7R is aberrantly overexpressed, particularly in leukemia stem cells (LSCs) and AML blasts.

pmc-13297506.title: Tomato Polyphenols Protect Human Red Blood Cells from Mercury-Induced Oxidative Stress and Phosphatidylserine Exposure
pmc-13297506.creator: Claudia Moriello, Nicola Alessio, Rosario Finamore, Chiara De Rosa, Chiara Schiraldi, Caterina Manna, Stefania D’Angelo, Pasquale Perrone
pmc-13297506.description: Oxidative stress plays a central role in the development of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) and is strongly influenced by environmental toxicants such as heavy metals. Mercury (Hg) is a well-known pro-oxidant agent capable of disrupting cellular redox homeostasis, promoting reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, and inducing structural and functional alterations in circulating blood cells.

pmc-13318856.title: Editorial: GenAI in healthcare: technologies, applications and evaluation
pmc-13318856.creator: Tim Hulsen, Mark C. Scheper, Steffen C. Pauws

pmc-13361823.title: A novel Vector-Symbolic Architecture for graph encoding and its application to viral pangenome-based species classification
pmc-13361823.creator: Fabio Cumbo, Kabir Dhillon, Jayadev Joshi, Davide Chicco, Sercan Aygun, Daniel Blankenberg
pmc-13361823.description: Viral species classification is crucial for understanding viral evolution, epidemiology, and developing effective diagnostics and treatments. Traditional methods often rely on sequence similarity, which can be challenging for rapidly evolving viruses. Pangenomes, offering a comprehensive representation of species’ genomic diversity, provide a richer perspective, but their analysis often requires advanced computational methods.

pmc-13465084.title: Integrated Histological and Transcriptomic Characterization of Prolonged Starvation Responses in the Cavefish Triplophysa rosa
pmc-13465084.creator: Zechen Wu, Luyun Ni, Yuan Xu, Yongming Wang, Feng Shao, Zuogang Peng
pmc-13465084.description: Simple SummaryCaves are dark, isolated, and food-poor habitats. Animals living in caves must therefore make careful use of limited energy to survive. The cavefish Triplophysa rosa lives in such an environment, but little is known about how it copes when food is unavailable for a long time.

pmc-13486793.title: Molecular determinants of arginine versus lysine cation–π interactions in biomolecular condensates
pmc-13486793.creator: Lydia Armentia, Xabier López, David De Sancho
pmc-13486793.description: Biomolecular condensates formed by intrinsically disordered regions of proteins are primarily stabilised by amino acid “stickers” that crosslink polypeptide chains. While aromatic and positively charged residues both act as “stickers”, their interaction mechanisms differ. Quantifying these differences is essential since they determine the fate of multicomponent mixtures.

pmc-13647046.title: Knockout of hsd3b1 disrupts steroid hormone homeostasis and compromises gonadal development in zebrafish
pmc-13647046.creator: Lijia He, Yaqing Wang, Zhiqin Ren, Chaofan Wang, Rui Qu, Houpeng Wang, Ding Ye, Zhengfang Chen, Yonghua Sun
pmc-13647046.description: Steroid hormones are central regulators of gonadal differentiation, endocrine homeostasis, and reproductive function, with impaired steroid biosynthesis leading to metabolic dysfunction and reproductive disease. 3β-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (3β-HSD), encoded by HSD3B, catalyzes the conversion of inactive Δ5-3β-hydroxysteroid precursors into bioactive Δ4-ketosteroids, representing a pivotal enzymatic step in steroidogenesis.

uslaw-cfr-t25-s15-7.title: 25 C.F.R. § 15.7 — What is a self-proved will?
uslaw-cfr-t25-s15-7.creator: Bureau Of Indian Affairs, Department Of The Interior
uslaw-cfr-t25-s15-7.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 25 (Indians), Part 15 (Probate Of Indian Estates, Except For Members Of The Osage Nation And The Five Civilized Tribes).
